summaryZh: Schroeder 实验室研究植物抵抗干旱、升高的二氧化碳、盐和重金属胁迫的信号通路，重点涉及保卫细胞及气孔调节。团队在拟南芥和禾草遗传突变体中结合细胞分子分析、膜片钳和时间分辨钙成像。
researchQuestions: 植物如何响应大气中二氧化碳浓度的持续上升？
哪些基因介导植物盐胁迫抗性，以及重金属摄取和解毒？
methods: 拟南芥与禾草遗传突变体

evidence.quote: Julian I. Schroeder Professor of Biology, UCSD

Our laboratory's research is directed at the signal transduction mechanisms and pathways that mediate resistance to abiotic stresses in plants, in particular responses to elevated drought, CO 2 , salt stress, and heavy metal stress.

In guard cells, cell biological, molecular, patch clamp and time-resolved calcium imaging studies on genetic signaling mutants in Arabidopsis and in cereal grasses are allowing us to identify and characterize stress-induced signal transduction mechanisms and cascades.
Two guard cells surround each pore and control the opening and closing of stomata.
Julian I. Schroeder Professor of Biology, UCSD

Several abiotic stress mechanisms that we are characterizing are directly linked to water, including drought stress-induced signal transduction mechanisms, salinity resistance mechanisms and how plants respond to the continuing rise in the atmospheric CO 2 concentration.
A second effort in the lab focuses on identifying genes that mediate salt (sodium/salinity) stress resistance and heavy metal uptake and detoxification in plants.
